post.description: Evaluates an EL expression the way the workflow engine would in the given scope. Scopes that use `event` need `eventId` (a stored stream event). get.summary: Get the lineage graph of an entity
get.description: Returns the upstream (origin) and downstream (results) graph of work linked to an entity: stream events, traces, workflow runs and tasks. Each node carries a status, a UI link and its direct AI cost. Edges always point from the upstream node to the downstream node. The walk is bounded by `depth` (hops in each direction) and `maxNodes`; when either limit cuts the graph short, `truncated` is true. References to rows removed by data retention are returned as nodes with `available` false.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Which side of the graph to return: `upstream` (origin), `downstream` (results) or `both` (default)

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Maximum number of hops to walk in each direction (1-10, default 5)

parameters.name: maxNodes
parameters.description: Maximum number of nodes to return (1-1000, default 200)
